channel.title: Kitchen Conversions & Recipe Scaling
channel.description: Cups, spoons, mL, grams, oven temperatures, and how to halve or double a recipe, with free printable charts.

item.title: How to Halve a Recipe: Half of 3/4 Cup, 1/3 Cup, 1 Tbsp
item.description: Half of 3/4 cup is 1/3 cup + 2 tsp. Half of 1/3 cup is 2 tbsp + 2 tsp. Half of 1/4 cup is 2 tbsp, and half of 1 tbsp is 1 1/2 tsp. The free printable kitchen chart also covers thirds, 1 1/2 times, doubles, cups to mL, grams, and oven temperatures.

item.title: How Many Tablespoons in a Cup? (Free Kitchen Conversion Chart)
item.description: 1 cup is 16 tbsp, 3/4 cup is 12 tbsp, 1/3 cup is 5 tbsp + 1 tsp, and 1/4 cup is 4 tbsp. The free printable kitchen chart also converts cups and spoons to fluid ounces and mL, grams to ounces, and oven temperatures.
